recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. If this behavior regresses, the fix should be made in the current Kindling/publisher rendering code rather than by adding redundant FHIR source text or editing generated HTML.
issue_request: FHIR-13854 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive STU3 FHIR-core request to make indented terminology codes keep subsequent wrapped lines aligned with their hierarchy indentation; the reported example was the old Condition Clinical Status value-set page where the wrapped "controlled" portion of "well-controlled" started to the left of "well".
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 12697, represented in git as 038fdaf932646e6b90cefc292e56c451cb7a24c3, which added non-wrapping treatment to value-set/code-system code columns in NarrativeGenerator. A same-day follow-up, c3dfb0030501b80f6e7150544cfb41d4145e5d60, changed that application from the obsolete nowrap attribute to style="white-space:nowrap".
additional_context: The old in-repository Java NarrativeGenerator was deleted in 2021, and the current FHIR build invokes the external org.hl7.fhir:kindling dependency. The current Condition value-set source remains in build scope, but it now includes the THO condition-clinical code system rather than carrying the old well-controlled code locally. The current CI-built value-set expansion still renders the hierarchical Code column with style="white-space:nowrap" on the header and code cells.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current generated specification already has the non-wrapping code-cell behavior requested by FHIR-13854, and there is no authoritative in-repository renderer source that needs a duplicate fix.
